data.name: DataSetListInfo
data.value: You can quickly populate JIM with example data, as a way to demo, or prototype new features without needing to fully configure JIM with Connected Systems, Synchronisation Rules and wait for data to be imported and synchronised. Example Data Sets provide the raw values that are used to construct example data in Example Data Templates.
data.comment: Help text on the Data Sets list page.

data.name: TemplateListInfo
data.value: You can quickly populate JIM with example data, as a way to demo, or prototype new features without needing to fully configure JIM with Connected Systems, Synchronisation Rules and wait for data to be imported and synchronised. Templates define example data to be created in JIM. They consist of one or more object types, with data sets being used to generate values for the object attributes.
data.comment: Help text on the templates list page.

data.name: DataSetDetailInfo
data.value: An Example Data Set is a named list of values, such as first names or job titles, that Example Data Templates draw on to generate attribute values. A built-in set cannot be changed.
data.comment: Help text on the Data Set detail page.

data.name: TemplateDetailInfo
data.value: A template describes the Metaverse Objects to generate: how many of each Object Type, and how each attribute's values are made. Executing it adds those objects to the Metaverse, where JIM never deletes them automatically.
data.comment: Help text on the template detail page.
